meta.description: Quick reference for the parameters of 19 mainstream encryption algorithms, with status filtering, search and click-a-row to copy the algorithm name.
meta.title: Crypto Algorithm Comparison - S-Jiffy
u.aes128: Data encryption, TLS transport, disk encryption
u.dsa: Only for government and legacy compatibility
u.ecc: TLS certificates, TLS 1.3 key exchange, signatures
u.rc4: Fully deprecated (attacks on WEP, legacy TLS)
u.scrypt: Password storage, resistant to custom hardware
u.sha1: Legacy protocol compatibility only; collision attacks found
u.sha2: General secure hashing, digital signatures, TLS
ui.100: Search algorithm name or purpose keyword...
ui.101: Click any row to copy the algorithm name; the “Recommended” status is suitable for new systems, “Deprecated” only for legacy compatibility, and “Insecure” must not be used in security contexts.
